title: 항만지역등 대기질 개선에 관한 특별법 시행규칙 / queue:ARTICLE:3:0:00003:part:1/1
title_original: 항만지역등 대기질 개선에 관한 특별법 시행규칙
full_text:
Article 3 (Designation of Emission Control Areas)
(1) When the Minister of Maritime Affairs and Fisheries designates an emission control area (hereinafter referred to as "emission control area") in accordance with Article 10(1) of the Act, the Minister must obtain the opinions of the mayor/governor/special autonomous province governor (hereinafter referred to as "mayor/governor") of the area designated as the emission control area, and the port authority under the "Port Authority Act" (hereinafter referred to as "port authority").
(2) When the Minister of Maritime Affairs and Fisheries designates an emission control area, the Minister must announce the location, purpose, operating method, and other necessary information for that area.
